title: Reading Practice Test 11 – Banking & Finance
description: Đề luyện Reading theo cấu trúc đề thi TOEIC (IIG Việt Nam), rút gọn 28 câu: Part 5 (10) · Part 6 (4, có câu điền cả câu) · Part 7 (14: thông báo, e-mail khoản vay, bài báo có chèn câu, đoạn kép). Chủ đề: ngân hàng, tài khoản, khoản vay, ngân hàng số.

questions.content: The bank will ------- a small fee for international money transfers.
questions.explanation: Sau 'will' dùng động từ nguyên mẫu → 'charge' (tính phí).

questions.content: Customers can check their account balances ------- by using our mobile app.
questions.explanation: Bổ nghĩa cho động từ 'check' → trạng từ 'conveniently' (một cách tiện lợi).

questions.content: The finance committee ------- the annual budget at its next meeting.
questions.explanation: 'at its next meeting' → tương lai 'will review'.

questions.content: Interest rates have remained ------- stable over the past six months.
questions.explanation: Trạng từ bổ nghĩa cho tính từ 'stable' → 'relatively stable' (tương đối ổn định).

questions.content: The loan application must be signed ------- both applicants.
questions.explanation: Câu bị động, chỉ người thực hiện hành động → 'by'.

questions.content: ------- the company's profits rose last year, it did not hire any new staff.
questions.explanation: Hai mệnh đề đối lập (lợi nhuận tăng – nhưng không tuyển thêm) → 'Although' + mệnh đề. 'Despite' + danh từ.

questions.content: Please review your monthly statement carefully and report any ------- immediately.
questions.explanation: Sau 'any' cần danh từ làm tân ngữ của 'report' → 'errors'.

questions.content: Mr. Tan was appointed chief financial officer ------- his experience in international banking.
questions.explanation: Theo sau là cụm danh từ 'his experience…' và chỉ lý do → 'because of'.

questions.content: The investment firm ------- financial advice to clients for more than 30 years.
questions.explanation: 'for more than 30 years' (kéo dài tới nay) → hiện tại hoàn thành 'has provided'.

questions.content: The audit revealed that the company's financial records were ------- accurate.
questions.explanation: Trạng từ bổ nghĩa cho tính từ 'accurate' → 'completely accurate'.

groups.passage:
Dear Ms. Romero,

Your new Pinnacle Bank debit card is enclosed. For your security, the card must be activated ---131--- it can be used.

To activate your card, simply call the number on the sticker on the front of the card or log in to our mobile app. ---132---. Once your card is activated, please sign the back of it.

Your new card includes contactless payment technology, which allows you to pay by tapping the card on a ---133--- payment terminal. Purchases made this way are protected by the same security features as ordinary card transactions.

If you did not request this card, please call us at 1-800-555-0148 ---134--- we can cancel it.

Sincerely,
Card Services
Pinnacle Bank

questions.explanation: Thẻ phải được kích hoạt 'trước khi' sử dụng → 'before'.

options.B: You will be asked to enter the last four digits of your account number.
options.C: Interest rates may change next year.
options.D: Our branch is closed on Sundays.

questions.explanation: Đoạn đang hướng dẫn kích hoạt thẻ → câu chèn tiếp nối bước kích hoạt: nhập 4 số cuối tài khoản.
Tính từ (dạng V-ing) bổ nghĩa cho 'payment terminal': máy thanh toán 'có tham gia/chấp nhận' → 'participating'.
Chỉ mục đích (gọi để chúng tôi huỷ thẻ) → 'so that' + mệnh đề. 'in order' phải là 'in order to + V'.

groups.passage:
NOTICE TO CUSTOMERS

Beginning Monday, August 5, the Elm Street branch of First Harbor Bank will close at 4:00 P.M. on weekdays instead of 6:00 P.M. Saturday hours, 9:00 A.M. to 1:00 P.M., will not change.

Our ATMs will remain available 24 hours a day. Customers can also make deposits, pay bills, and transfer money at any time through our online banking service.

We appreciate your understanding.

questions.content: What is changing at the Elm Street branch?
questions.explanation: Chi nhánh đóng cửa lúc 4 giờ chiều ngày thường thay vì 6 giờ. Giờ thứ Bảy không đổi.

questions.content: What is suggested about customers?

options.A: They must visit the branch on Saturdays.
options.C: They need to open new accounts.
options.D: They can still use some services after the branch closes.

questions.explanation: ATM hoạt động 24/24 và có ngân hàng trực tuyến → vẫn giao dịch được sau giờ chi nhánh đóng cửa.

groups.passage:
To: Jason Park
From: Melissa Grant, Summit Credit Union
Date: February 11
Subject: Your loan application

Dear Mr. Park,

Thank you for applying for a small business loan with Summit Credit Union. We have reviewed your application for a $40,000 loan to purchase equipment for your bakery.

Before we can make a final decision, we need a few additional documents: your business's tax returns for the past two years and a copy of your current lease agreement. You can upload these documents through our secure online portal or bring them to any branch.

Once we receive the documents, a decision will usually be made within five business days. If you have any questions, please call me directly at 555-0163.

Sincerely,
Melissa Grant
Loan Officer

questions.content: Why did Mr. Park apply for a loan?
questions.explanation: '…a $40,000 loan to purchase equipment for your bakery.'

questions.content: What is Mr. Park asked to provide?
questions.explanation: Hồ sơ thuế 2 năm (tài chính) và hợp đồng thuê mặt bằng (lease) → giấy tờ tài chính và thuê.

questions.content: What is indicated about the decision on the loan?

options.A: It is usually made within a week of receiving the documents.
options.C: It will be sent by mail.
options.D: It requires a meeting at a branch.

questions.explanation: 'A decision will usually be made within five business days' – 5 ngày làm việc ≈ trong vòng một tuần.

groups.passage:
More Customers Choose Digital Banking

A survey released last week by the National Banking Association found that 72 percent of adults now do most of their banking on their phones or computers, up from 55 percent five years ago. [1]

The shift has led many banks to reduce the number of branches they operate. Harbor National Bank, for example, closed 30 branches last year but hired 200 new employees for its customer support and technology teams. [2]

Not all customers are happy with the change, however. Some older customers say they prefer to speak with a teller in person. [3] In response, several banks have started offering video calls with bank staff, as well as free classes to help customers learn to use online services. [4]

questions.content: What is the article mainly about?

options.D: A new type of bank card

questions.explanation: 72% người dùng giao dịch chủ yếu qua điện thoại/máy tính → xu hướng ngân hàng số tăng.

questions.content: What did Harbor National Bank do last year?

options.B: It reduced its customer support team.
options.D: It shifted resources from branches to other areas.

questions.explanation: Đóng 30 chi nhánh nhưng tuyển 200 nhân viên hỗ trợ khách hàng và công nghệ → chuyển nguồn lực.

questions.content: The word "shift" in paragraph 2, line 1, is closest in meaning to
questions.explanation: 'The shift' = sự chuyển dịch (sang ngân hàng số) → change. 'work period' là nghĩa 'ca làm việc' – bẫy.

questions.content:
In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong?
"Others worry about the security of their personal information."
questions.explanation: 'Others' đối ứng với 'Some older customers' ở câu trước – cùng liệt kê lý do khách không hài lòng → vị trí [3].

groups.passage:
Crestview Bank – Checking Accounts

Everyday Checking: No monthly fee with a minimum balance of $500; otherwise $8 per month. Free online banking.
Premier Checking: $15 monthly fee, waived with a balance of $5,000 or more. Earns 0.5% interest. Free checks and no ATM fees worldwide.
Student Checking: No monthly fee for customers aged 18 to 24 who are enrolled in college. Free online banking.

Open an account online by June 30 and receive a $100 bonus after your first direct deposit.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

To: support@crestviewbank.com
From: Hiroshi Kato
Date: June 12
Subject: New account

Hello,

I recently moved to the area for a new job and would like to open a checking account. I travel overseas for work several times a year, so avoiding ATM fees abroad is important to me. I expect to keep a balance of around $7,000 in the account.

I also have a question about the bonus. My employer will begin paying my salary by direct deposit on July 15. Would I still be eligible for the bonus if I open the account online this week?

Thank you,
Hiroshi Kato

questions.content: What is true about the Everyday Checking account?

options.B: Its monthly fee can be avoided.

questions.explanation: 'No monthly fee with a minimum balance of $500' → có thể tránh phí hằng tháng.

questions.content: Why did Mr. Kato write the e-mail?

options.B: To inquire about a new account

questions.explanation: Anh muốn mở tài khoản thanh toán và hỏi về tiền thưởng.

questions.content: Which account will Mr. Kato most likely open?
questions.explanation: Anh hay đi nước ngoài và muốn tránh phí ATM → Premier Checking ('no ATM fees worldwide').

questions.content: How much will Mr. Kato most likely pay in monthly fees?
questions.explanation: Phí $15 của gói Premier được miễn khi số dư từ $5,000; anh dự định duy trì khoảng $7,000 → $0.

questions.content: What is suggested about the bonus?

options.C: Mr. Kato is likely to qualify for it.
options.D: It must be requested at a branch.

questions.explanation: Điều kiện: mở tài khoản online trước 30/6 và nhận thưởng sau lần nhận lương chuyển khoản đầu tiên – anh mở trong tuần này (tháng 6) và nhận lương từ 15/7 → nhiều khả năng đủ điều kiện.
